Loan & Marketing Officer Job at Gabs Cooperative




        
    

        
        Gabs Cooperative is a leading financial institution dedicated to empowering SMEs, public servants, and civil servants with easy access to affordable loans. With a focus on financial inclusion and growth, we offer low-interest-rate loans tailored to meet diverse financial needs. Our mission is to provide reliable and flexible financial solutions that drive economic stability and prosperity. At Gabs Cooperative, we are committed to helping our clients achieve their financial goals with transparency, integrity, and exceptional service.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Loan & Marketing Officer
     

            
    



Job Location: Central Business District, Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Description


	We are looking for a dedicated Loan & Marketing Officer to join our team.
	This role is perfect for a detail-oriented professional who can balance meticulous loan processing with a proactive approach to business development and customer relationship management.


Responsibilities


	Processing loan applications and documentation within specified limits.
	Maintain and update account records to ensure accuracy and compliance.
	Develop referral networks and explore alternate channels to enhance customer acquisition.
	Cross-sell products and services to achieve sales targets.
	Build and maintain trust relationships with customers to enhance loyalty and satisfaction throughout the underwriting process.
	Ensure compliance with lending laws, regulations, and company policies.
	Marketing our various products.


Requirements


	Minimum educational qualification of an SSCE, HND, and B.Sc. Degree
	Strong communication and negotiation skills.
	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
	Must be based in Abuja.


Salary
N181,000 - N350,000 / Month.

Additional Benefits: Pension, 13th Month Allowance, Leave Allowance, Health Insurance, and Professional Growth Opportunities.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and a cover letter to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Mechanical Manager Job at Ascentech Services Limited




        
    

        
        Ascentech Services Limited is the most sought-after Human Resource Solution Provider with its Head Office in Lagos, Nigeria. We have a reputation for satisfying and surpassing clients' expectations through our core offerings: Recruitment and Selection, Outsourcing, Training and Development. To accomplish these we leverage creating and managing change in organizations by improving efficiency through our proven and dynamic HR solutions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Mechanical Manager

Job Location: Sagamu, Ogun
Employment Type: Full-time
Start Date: Immediate

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Manager to oversee mechanical maintenance, equipment reliability, and plant operations.


Key Responsibilities


	Handle mechanical breakdowns and preventive maintenance.
	Conduct 5-Why/RCA and implement corrective actions.
	Plan and coordinate shutdown and maintenance activities.
	Manage mechanical spare-parts inventory.
	Maintain accurate maintenance records and equipment service history.
	Ensure compliance with safety and maintenance procedures.


Requirements


	B.Tech/HND in Mechanical Engineering.
	8 – 10 years of relevant mechanical maintenance experience.
	Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
	Experience in shutdown planning and spare-parts management.
	Good computer, documentation, and leadership skills.


Salary
Negotiable.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: [email protected] using “Mechanical Manager – Sagamu” as the subject of the email.
